My Approach

Start with the work.
Understand the people.

I’m drawn to the questions around the implementation: What problem are we solving? Who needs to use this? How will it fit into the way the organization works?

That perspective connects my interests in architecture, automation, and leadership. I want to make technology decisions with enough technical depth to understand the tradeoffs—and enough context to know why they matter.

Where I’m Headed

Broader ownership.
Thoughtful technology leadership.

I’m building toward technology leadership and management, combining hands-on technical understanding with a broader view of people, systems, and business needs.

My interests include cybersecurity, systems architecture, automation, and business transformation. I want to help shape technology decisions, improve how organizations work, and lead teams through meaningful change.

Based in Fayetteville, Arkansas. Currently pursuing a master’s in Information Systems with a focus in Cybersecurity Management.
